card.name: Inside all-caps boxed warning headings
card.fires_on: Words and word parts inside all-caps boxed warning titles, such as the end of ARTERIAL, commas, AND, OF or INCLUDING between listed risks. It fires where the heading is still running and more risk terms follow.

modes.label: Partway through caps words
modes.description: Inside a long capitalized medical word in a warning title.

modes.label: Linking words and commas
modes.description: Commas or small linking words between risks in an all-caps warning list.
modes.example: WARNING: QT PROLONGATION<<,>> TORSADES DE POINTES, and

modes.label: Linking words after risk
modes.description: OF or INCLUDING linking a risk phrase to the next term in a caps heading.
modes.example: INCREASES THE RISK<< OF>> THROMBOTIC EVENTS: Premature

card.plain: It fires inside the capitalized headline of a boxed warning, as it moves from one listed risk to the next.
